stem:
Two shapes are shown below. Describe one way they are the same and one way they are different.

[Image: Two triangles, labeled Shape P and Shape Q]

B. Different

codes.response: One has a right angle, one does not.
One has 2 sides/ angles the same size/is isoceles/has a line of symmetry (the other does not)
One is bigger/longer/wider/has a larger area than the other or equivalent statement about size.
They are different shapes/ they are not the same shape.
Other incorrect (including crossed out, erased, stray marks, illegible, or off task)

figure_description: Two geometric shapes side by side: on the left is "Shape P", a right-angled triangle with a vertical left side, a horizontal bottom side, and a hypotenuse sloping down and to the right. On the right is "Shape Q", an acute isosceles triangle with a horizontal base and two equal-length sloping sides meeting at a top vertex.
